issue.title: Bug:[test_fib.py] Function test_ecmp_group_member_flap failed from time to time

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Test test_ecmp_group_member_flap of test_fib.py failed from time to time due to 2 main reason:
1. After shuting down one uplink port, sleep 10 seconds may not enough for routes update.
2. The src port may choose one member of the uplink port, and the member of the same portchannel may be shutdown by the script, in this scenario, the packet forwarding would be blocked. The src port choose algorithm need to be updated to avoid this specific scenario.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test case test_ecmp_group_member_flap of fib/test_fib.py

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Packet forward would be blocked from time to time on many topology including t0-56 / t1-32-lag / t1-64-lag / t1-lag.


### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
This fixes issue mentioned in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/17887.
For pizza box DUTs, multi-port portchannel scenario was not handled, which caused issue on certain specific topologies.

#### How did you do it?
Add all members of PORT_CHANNEL (if the port being shutdown is part of PORT_CHANNEL) to the filtered ports list, so that during fib_test, these ports are not randomly picked as src port.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verified on t1-lag topology. the testcase passes.
